master_projects.title: Telemetry Gateway
bullets: Built a FreeRTOS gateway in C that collected readings from 24 sensors over SPI.
Designed MQTT retries and offline buffering for intermittent field connectivity.
Reduced telemetry packet loss from 8% to 1.5% during a 72-hour field test.

master_projects.title: Vibration Test Rig
bullets: Built an STM32 vibration controller in C++ with CAN commands for six motor channels.
Added Python calibration scripts that generated repeatable test reports from 400 samples.
Cut fixture setup time from 45 minutes to 12 minutes by automating calibration.

master_projects.title: Order API Platform
bullets: Built a TypeScript Node.js API for order creation, inventory checks, and audit history.
Designed PostgreSQL indexes and Redis caching for the highest-volume order queries.
Handled 180 requests per second in a load test with p95 latency below 180 ms.

master_projects.title: Operations Dashboard
bullets: Built a React and TypeScript dashboard showing live equipment alerts from a REST API.
Added filter state, accessible tables, and drill-down views for 14 alert categories.
Reduced weekly spreadsheet review time from 6 hours to 90 minutes.

master_projects.title: Support Dashboard
bullets: Built a React and TypeScript support dashboard for ticket queues and SLA status.
Implemented REST pagination and saved filters for three support teams.
Improved first-response tracking by replacing a manual CSV workflow.

master_projects.title: Demand Forecasting
bullets: Trained a scikit-learn demand model in Python from 8,000 historical order records.
Used pandas feature windows and a time-based validation split to compare three regressors.
Improved mean absolute error by 18% against the seasonal-naive baseline.

master_projects.title: Inspection Classifier
bullets: Built a PyTorch image classifier in Python for 12,000 labeled inspection images.
Used OpenCV preprocessing and augmentation to normalize lighting across four cameras.
Reached 91% validation accuracy and reduced manual inspection samples by 30%.

master_projects.title: Edge Device Service
bullets: Built a Go gRPC service that synchronized device configuration with an edge database.
Packaged the service with Docker and added SQLite migrations for offline deployments.
Recovered configuration after simulated network outages in under 20 seconds.
Automated Python test reports for embedded fixtures.
